title: AEGIS2.0: A Diverse AI Safety Dataset and Risks Taxonomy for Alignment of LLM Guardrails
reasoning: The paper presents a safety taxonomy that includes an 'Immoral/Unethical' category (S23) and a 'Hate/Identity Hate' category (S8) that explicitly includes religion as a protected characteristic. It benchmarks Large Language Models on their ability to correctly categorize and moderate content based on these ethical and religious dimensions.
